$comment: envision board.json, schema 1. This sample is the schema document: every key below is required, every list shows one entry at least, and render.cjs refuses any key not shown here. Text is plain text. step is the page's step this round, 1 Pick a direction, 2 Try it, 3 Sort what's in, 4 Agree. appetite, tone (verbatim words) and notes (engineering facts the user volunteered, verbatim) are never themes in heard. Enums: status exploring|agreed|draft; features[].bucket first|later|no; features[].source said|picked|guess; open[].kind tension|decision|question; feel.source ""|adopt|impeccable|claude-design|in-session. open[].who is "me" (the owner), "" (nobody named yet) or a person's name; a tension's who is always "me". The look (feel) stays empty until status is agreed. outcome is "" unless status is draft, then "On hold", "Not building it: <why>" or "Solved without building: <how-to>". Ids (concepts, screens, features, open, feel.tiles) are unique across the board. A sketch (concepts[].home, screens[].wireframe) is a tree of {type: row|col, children: [...]} and regions {type, label (1-40), copy (<=120), feature (a features id), go (a screens id)}, regions being nav header text list card table form field button image tabs modal empty badge: no colour, font or size fields.
